summary.content:
Today's selection covers 69 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 45 on Artificial Intelligence and 12 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI says it cracked 90-year-old maths problem in 88 hours
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Scammers demand ransoms from Instagram users over fake copyright claims
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, Dark Reading, The Verge, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 57 articles published in the last 24 hours
